@graph.description:
Runtime blackbox port of nav2_system_tests/src/localization. The upstream test
publishes an initial pose and checks that AMCL publishes a matching amcl_pose within
0.25 m in x/y. The scenario framework has no generic topic-publish primitive, so
robot.init_nav2(start_pose) provides the equivalent AMCL initialization, and a short
navigation goal is added to produce behavior_tree_log events for BT tracking and
coverage. Localization is graded from recorded amcl_pose/ground-truth data in the
analysis notebook; navigation is only the BT-observation harness.
@graph.title: Nav2 localization initial-pose test with BT tracking, TurtleBot 4 + Nav2
